angle: DL/EDGE: pass-rush drill first-second distance (burst) and Run-the-Hoop Hoop G (bend) vs NFL NGS get-off and pressure rate; year-standardized; baseline = weight + 10-yd split + 3-cone + NGS athleticism + log pick + EDGE share (also run without EDGE share)
metric_name: Hoop G (peak sideways/centripetal acceleration held 0.5 s on Run-the-Hoop, g, z within Combine year) and drill first-second distance (yd covered in the 1.0 s after movement onset in the pass-rush drill)
headline_number: Hoop G vs NFL pressure beyond the no-tracking baseline: partial rho 0.32 [0.06, 0.57], n=63; out-of-class R2 0.07 -> 0.14 (dR2 +0.073 [-0.086, 0.214], within-class permutation p=0.022, Holm p=0.063 over 4 tests); +0.64 pp pressure per sd (~2.9 pressures per 450 rushes). Drill burst vs NGS get-off: partial rho -0.11 [-0.33, 0.13], n=68, smallest detectable true effect 0.78 because drill reliability is 0.22 -> 'cannot detect', not 'does not translate'.
what_changed_from_previous: DL-only rewrite merging the round-1 winner's burst framing with cand_1's Hoop G lead and applying judge top_changes: (1) NFL burst now measured by NGS get-off over every rush (validated per-play rho -0.80 vs tracked first-second distance; season-to-season 0.84) instead of ~6 tracked snaps, which shows the drill side is the noisy side; (2) power/MDE on observed and true-score scales plus TOST for every null, verdict made conditional; (3) burst defined as first-second distance; pressure source explained (league play-level charting, pooled-prior beta-binomial so EDGE is not built into the outcome); (4) official 40/10-yd/3-cone/shuttle vs pressure and get-off tested and shown; tracked 40 top speed tested over official 40 (adds -0.092); (5) opportunity/injury check (Hoop G vs snaps and games per season ~0); (6) baseline hygiene: stored random-half flag used, weight year-standardized, with/without EDGE share, per-fold results incl. 2025, outcome reliability by seasons; (7) blind 2025 draft-room card (trained on 2023-24) with 80% bands, bend up/down flags and a 'what would change my mind' 2026 threshold (partial rho <= -0.18); (8) WR/OL/TE/DB cut; 5 figures + 1 table, hero figure redesigned with traces + z-bars + snap counts.
open_risks: Hoop G was selected in round 1 from six drill metrics on the same players; permutation p 0.022 does not correct for this and Holm p is 0.063; out-of-class dR2 CI includes zero.

Small held-out classes (20-22) and 2025 has one season: 2025 fold R2 is negative for both models (level shift), so the card is for order not levels; rank rho improves in 2 of 3 classes (2024 slightly worse).
Hoop reliability rests on split halves of single runs (only 10 players ran twice); 3-cone is imputed for 42 of 69 cohort players.

Exploratory drill-vs-tracked-game first-second link (partial 0.33, EDGE 0.42) was found after looking and conflicts superficially with the NGS get-off null; explained as reaction vs post-start acceleration but untested.
Pressure comes from league charting; no opponent, scheme or injury data, so opportunity/injury handled only via snaps and games per season.
